senses.gloss: (b. h.; אול to turn) prep. to, toward.—Pl., with prefix מ a. suffix of pers. pron., of itself, of my (his &c.) own accord, on my (his &c.) authority.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 5b:3">Yoma 5ᵇ</cite> <he>לא מֵאֵלַי</he> not on my own authority. Orlah I, 2 <he>העולה מֵאֵלָיו</he> growing spontaneously.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:3:12">Y. Peah VII, 20ᵇ</cite> bot. its sacred character <he>מֵאֵלָיו למדו</he> they did derive from itself (i.e. from the wording of the law itself).—Hence <he>מִמֵּילָא</he>, v. <cite ref="M01162"><he>מֵילָא</he></cite>.
